en.headline: Marine Department coordinates with Guangdong ahead of Friday yacht first voyage
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said preparations include captain training, real-time monitoring and an electronic service system for the southbound Guangdong yachts.
body: The first voyage under the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao yacht free travel arrangement known as Yue Ting Nan Xia will take place on Friday, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said.

Speaking on a radio programme, Chan said the Marine Department had been in close communication with the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration to prepare for the debut. Over recent months the government had trained and assessed mainland captains on knowledge of Hong Kong waters.

The Marine Department has also built a real-time yacht monitoring system to facilitate berthing, and an electronic business system offering one-stop services for crews and visitors. Chan said the government would strengthen information and safety reminders to the yachts, step up patrols, and work with the industry on business opportunities and supporting facilities.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下周五行首航 海事處與廣東密切溝通做好準備
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，當局已進行船長培訓考核、建立實時監察系統及電子業務系統，並會加強安全提示及巡邏。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，「粵艇南下」將於星期五首航，本港海事處與廣東海事局密切溝通及聯繫，為首航做好準備。
陳美寶在電台節目表示，過去幾個月特區政府已就內地船長對香港水域的知識進行訓練和考核。海事處亦已構建實時遊艇動態監察系統，方便粵艇停泊，並設有電子業務系統為船員與遊客提供一站式便利服務。
她又表示，政府會加強向粵艇發放資訊與提示，注意海上安全，海事處會加強巡邏。當局亦會與業界密切溝通，為他們帶來更多商機，並希望業界做好配套。
